name: ebpf-programming-the-linux-kernel-slides
description: Linux Day talk: eBPF: Programming the Linux Kernel (Marp slides and live demo)

scripts.build:html: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/assets && cp -R assets dist/assets && marp slides.md --allow-local-files --html -o dist/slides.html
scripts.build:print-html: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/assets && cp -R assets dist/assets && marp slides.md --template bare --allow-local-files --html -o dist/slides-print.html
